properties.name: ord.autoconfigure
properties.description: Whether to enable ORD auto-configuration. Set to false to disable all ORD endpoints and beans.

properties.name: ord.api-base-path-documents
properties.description: Base path for serving ORD documents.

properties.name: ord.api-base-path-resources
properties.description: Base path for serving ORD API resources.

properties.name: ord.api-base-path-well-known
properties.description: Path for the ORD well-known endpoint.

properties.name: ord.application
properties.description: Application identifier used in the generated ORD document.

properties.name: ord.namespace
properties.description: Namespace used in the generated ORD document.

properties.name: ord.packages
properties.description: Java packages to scan for ORD annotations (e.g. @OrdPackage, @OrdApiResource). Enables annotation-based document generation when non-empty.

properties.name: ord.documents
properties.description: List of pre-built static ORD documents to load and serve. Enables static file mode when non-empty.

properties.name: ord.documents[].name
properties.description: Unique name for this ORD document. Used as the path segment in /ord/v1/documents/{name}.

properties.name: ord.documents[].path
properties.description: Resource path to the static ORD document JSON file (e.g. classpath:ord/my-document.json).

properties.name: ord.documents[].access-strategies
properties.description: Access strategies for this document. Use 'open' to allow unauthenticated access. Omit or leave empty to require Basic Auth.

properties.name: ord.credentials
properties.description: HTTP Basic Auth credentials for the ORD document endpoints. Key is username, value is bcrypt-encoded password (e.g. {bcrypt}<hash>). Required when any document uses Basic Auth access strategy.

properties.name: ord.api-resources
properties.description: List of static API resource files to serve. Enables the /ord/v1/resources/{name} endpoint when non-empty.

properties.name: ord.api-resources[].name
properties.description: Unique name for this API resource. Used as the path segment in /ord/v1/resources/{name}.

properties.name: ord.api-resources[].path
properties.description: Resource path to the static API resource file (e.g. classpath:ord/my-api.yaml).

properties.name: ord.api-resources[].media-type
properties.description: Media type of the API resource file (e.g. application/yaml, application/json).

properties.name: ord.api-resources[].access-strategies
properties.description: Access strategies for this API resource. Use 'open' to allow unauthenticated access. Omit or leave empty to require Basic Auth.

values.description: Document is publicly accessible without authentication.
API resource is publicly accessible without authentication.
